# Simon Hjerrild

Simon Hjerrild is a senior consultant physician (Overlæge), clinical associate professor (Klinisk lektor) and PhD who works with the ADHD team at Klinik 2, Afdeling for Psykoser, at Aarhus Universitetshospital, Psykiatrien, in Region Midtjylland [^src1][^src3][^src4]. He is a member, and identified as chair (Forperson), of the steering group (formandskab) for [[adhd-databasen|ADHD-databasen]], the Danish national quality database that monitors ADHD assessment and treatment [^src1][^src2][^src3][^src4]. He is also listed as chair (Forperson) of [[dansk-psykiatrisk-selskab|Dansk Psykiatrisk Selskab]] [^src2][^src4].

Hjerrild appears consistently across both the 2023 and 2024 annual reports of ADHD-databasen, which document the quality of ADHD diagnosis and treatment in Danish child, adolescent, and (from 2024) adult psychiatry [^src1][^src3]. In the 2023 report, covering the period 1 April 2023 to 31 March 2024, he is named as part of the chairmanship of ADHD-databasen, an institution administered jointly by overlæger from [[aarhus-universitetshospital-psykiatrien|Aarhus Universitetshospital, Psykiatrien]] and [[dps-midtjylland|DPS Midtjylland]] [^src1][^src2]. The report was produced under the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) and highlighted growing referral numbers, longer waiting times, and declining performance against most quality indicators in Danish child and adolescent psychiatry [^src1].

In the 2024 report, published by Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut and co-led by Shelagh Powell and Simon Hjerrild, the database for the first time presented data covering the adult population and private hospitals, alongside continuing challenges in registration practice, staffing, and waiting times in child and adolescent psychiatry [^src3][^src4]. That report also documents 11 quality indicators and notes modest progress, particularly in Region Midt, where efforts focused on improving registration practices and implementing shortened assessment pathways [^src3].
